### Peer-Reviewed Publications

```{r}
#| label: auto-pubs
#| echo: false
#| cache: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

# 1. Load the scholar package
if (!require("scholar")) install.packages("scholar")
library(scholar)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# 2. Your Google Scholar ID
scholar_id <- "fT8u5MwAAAAJ"

# 3. Fetch your publications
pubs <- get_publications(scholar_id)

# 4. Sort by year (most recent first) and format for printing
pubs |>
  arrange(desc(year)) |>
  # Add a column for the publication number
  mutate(pub_number = row_number()) |>
  # Use pwalk() to iterate over each ROW of the data frame
  pwalk(function(pub_number, author, year, title, journal, ...) {
    # The arguments here (author, year, etc.) now refer to the values in each row
    
    # Make your name bold in the author list
    author_bold <- str_replace(author, "D Simons", "**D Simons**")
    
    # Print each entry as a numbered list item in Markdown format
    cat(
      paste0(
        pub_number, ". ", 
        author_bold, " (", year, "). ",
        title, ". *",
        journal, "*.\n"
      )
    )
  })

```
